answer: An agent joins only when a sponsor freezes a 400 POA opal bond for it, and the ledger roots each sponsor over the meadow of every account it later introduced. When one clone is proven forged at settlement, the slash sweeps the whole meadow beneath each sponsor on its path, so all descendants forfeit their opal together. A farm of n aliases therefore risks 400n in bonds that compound with subtree volume, and an honest outsider guards its ivory standing and will not sponsor a stranger whose collapse would burn that stake.
